ruleset.name: mcpserverlite
ruleset.description:
Coding standard for the mcpserverlite GLPI plugin.
GLPI core has relied on PSR-12 since GLPI 10 (see https://glpi-developer-documentation.readthedocs.io/en/master/codingstandards.html). glpi-project/coding-standard (the old "GlpiStandard" ruleset referenced by the plugin tutorial) is marked abandoned on Packagist, so this plugin checks directly against PSR-12 instead of depending on it. This is also the standard glpi-project/plugin-ci-workflows looks for via a `.phpcs.xml` file at the plugin root.
